title: Choose the Keep layout
question: All three use the Forest Light look. Pick the layout to build, or pick one and use the note box to borrow from another.

options.label: A. Forest Light as chosen
options.thesis: The comp you picked: a dawn band with the counts beside the title, and orders as separate cards.
options.viewport: Short dawn band holding chapter and counts, three order cards with round icons, parchment readiness card, pine button.
options.risk: It leaves out the theme line, the Gate Trial target note, and the Hearth mission, so the build would have to fit those in.

options.label: B. Tall dawn, ruled orders
options.thesis: The dawn scene carries the chapter title, and today's orders read as one ruled list below the counts.
options.viewport: A taller scene with The Muster and Answer the call., then day and Gate Trial counts on paper, a ruled orders list with a gold mark on the main order, readiness panel, Hearth row, pine button.
options.risk: The scene and counts take nearly half the screen, so readiness and the Hearth mission sit lower.

options.label: C. Compact band, readiness first
options.thesis: A short band holds everything about the chapter, so readiness and the main order own the screen.
options.viewport: Header, scene, chapter and counts in one band; readiness strip first; a featured main-order card with the two watches as tiles; Hearth row; pine button.
options.risk: The forest scene is small, and the watch tiles look tappable before they lead anywhere.
